description: Survey what changed before resuming work after a literal interruption: an app restart, a context cap, a machine sleep, a crash, or "resume" / "continue from where we left off" after the session went quiet while other sessions, the user, or automated jobs could have touched the repository. Trigger phrases include "cold start", "resume", "I had to restart", "continue from where we left off", "we may have changed files during the pause", "verify before writing". Do NOT use on the first turn of a brand-new session, or for a plain status question ("what's the state of X"), which is answered directly.
